body: {"better": "B", "reason": "Card A uses English word 'market' in 'సంతలో సరంజామా కొనవచ్చు' which misrepresents the venue (it's a produce market, not a general market for household items), and 'సరంజామా' is an invented detail not supported by the outing details. Card B correctly says 'తాజా కూరగాయలు' (fresh vegetables) matching the produce market description, uses natural coastal Andhra Telugu with respectful మీరు form 'చూడవచ్చు', and adds a clear reason to enjoy it. Both keep venue names in English
